title: Prove negative association of four binary full-guard indicators
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Prove negative association of **four** orthogonal binary rank-one-kernel full-guard indicators under one complete uniformly sampled `GL_m(F2)` header, for every `m >= 4`. Covariance is strictly negative for nonconstant increasing real functions on disjoint nonempty supports.

This closes Open next question 1 of lee-phys's #5073. The new step is the eight missing mixed-event inequalities for the `3+1` and `2+2` splits. The complete list has eleven types; exact signed-power-sum certificates prove every tail and exact arithmetic checks each finite prefix. A literal GL4 enumeration corroborates the boundary. A 1,344-header fixed-row slice has positive covariance between `E1` and `E2 AND E3`, so arbitrary restricted-header laws are explicitly excluded.

Only `research/corankone-four-negative-association/` is added. This is an author-checked scoped proof with an exact finite component, not a new counting law, physical supplier, admission result or kappa improvement. Five events, odd fields, nonorthogonal kernels and physical sampling/dispatch/restoration costs remain outside scope. No selected frontier is changed.

## Task and overlap

Canonical [claim and result: #5086](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5086), taking the [#5073 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19141140). Fresh-clone scientific base: `81e9bd69e4a5b00ba9c713a1620e36d576d5522e`, priority revision 7. Scope is **changed** from `formal-interface-lemma` to this explicit counting side question; the original catalogue card, reason, full boundary and source pins are retained in TASK/SOURCES.

Nearest predecessors:

- #5073, lee-phys, head `1aace155467e4a560bdb5b28f4f0fdc60a45c29d`: three-event negative association and the explicit four-event open question.
- #4599, Nick Petalas, head `19ca650c67ad2722790dc60c0bfd12989479b06a`: four-way intersection product bound, expressly excluding general negative association.
- Petalas's #4227/#4261/#4275 and #4777: cited counting laws and grouped three-event comparison. The exact proof bytes are pinned at the scientific base; no predecessor executable is imported or whole predecessor audit claimed.

This is separate from this account's earlier address-twist, carried-frame, dirty-fanout and permutation-cut work. Before claiming, live PR/Discussion coverage and six hours of own-account claims were checked. Canonical main was refetched unchanged at 08:50 UTC. The final snapshot covers all 313 open PR bodies (08:50:18 UTC) and 4,214 Discussion records (08:51:22 UTC); the matching live claim is this contribution's #5086. Targeted all-state PR searches and the claim's own replies were refreshed as well. Sparse notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered; no competing four-event negative-association result was found within this coverage.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.12/macOS, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/corankone-four-negative-association
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/corankone-four-negative-association --check-source-history
```

All four registered commands pass (both independent files, normal and optimized isolated Python). Evidence: 11 regenerated strict tail certificates, **692** finite-prefix comparisons, exhaustive 1/4/18 monotone-function classification, **3,939** direct atom/truth-table comparisons, 33 tail probes and eight rejection/domain controls. The separate literal checker enumerates **20,160 GL4 headers**, reproduces every atom and moment, and checks **174** strictly negative nonconstant event pairs plus **444** zero constant-involved pairs. Actual restricted-header and incorrect-inverse controls pass.

Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass. Both files also pass in normal/optimized Python from a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all seven exported files, including the receipt, retain identical hashes. Universal coverage comes from the written tail lemma and finite certificates, not extrapolation from samples.

No formal proof-kernel or independent human acceptance is claimed. No selected scientific cold replay, native/Lean/Docker build or full supplier admission was run. The selected sparse-input diagnostic reports 503 omitted files; the selected review/assumptions were read, but the full selected source-binding orientation was not run. [Hosted CI run 39927863766](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39927863766) also passed both planning (4m13s) and the focused package replay (1m18s) at exact head `c2809adad3fafb2a19f3dbf13753cf4d3865b9bf`; this is replay evidence, not independent scientific acceptance.

## Credit

Credit lee-phys and Nick Petalas as above, Cinna Davis's BIT request context, source527, commdata2338 and Jose Manuel's normalizer/closure lineage, and Chris R / Clear1nsight's counting context. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices and attribution retained.

## Open next questions

The README/TASK give two scoped next steps: derive the new `3+2` event inequalities for five orthogonal binary requests, or bind an actual paid caller to a complete uniform-header sampling rule before pricing its consumer. The present certificate settles neither; no follow-up is reserved.
